## Version Bump

A PR that changes anything outside `docs/` and `.github/` must tick one box;
the check fails until you do. CI sets the version from it:

- [ ] None: nothing users get changes, such as build tooling, tests, or a refactor
- [ ] Patch: fixes only, nothing new for users
- [ ] Minor: something new, such as a skill; existing setups keep working
- [ ] Major: users must change something, such as reconnecting, or a skill is removed or renamed
